Create a bleak industrial settlement on a dark uneven rocky plateau beneath a dim blue-gray starry sky. Arrange roughly eight to ten rusted metal structures in a loose oval around a broad empty yard, with a large tiered furnace anchoring one end and cylindrical workshops and chimney towers around the sides. Use heavy circular bases, stacked bands, domed or flat roofs, catwalk rails, pipes, and cables, with warm orange light in seams and doors and thin smoke above several stacks. Add sparse sheet-metal awnings, posts, puddle marks, mist, and pale boulders. Leave irregular perimeter gaps and let the plateau fall into bright fog-filled ravines with barren ridges beyond.
